subject: general
question: Select the correct option related to the function of auxin in plants.

options.text: Helps the cells to grow longer

solution:
The correct answer is __**Helps the cells to grow longer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Auxins** are a class of plant hormones that play a crucial role in the **growth and development** of plants.
 
• They are primarily involved in the **elongation of cells** in the shoots and roots.
 
• Auxins stimulate cell elongation by **loosening the cell walls**, which allows the cells to take up more water and expand.
 
• They are also involved in various other plant growth processes such as **apical dominance**, root initiation, and **fruit development**.
 
• Auxins are produced in the **apical meristems** (growth regions at the tips of roots and shoots) and are transported to other parts of the plant where they exert their effects.
 
• One of the most well-known auxins is **Indole-3-acetic acid (IAA)**, which is naturally occurring in plants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Make plants insect resistant**__

 __
 
• This function is not related to auxins. Instead, **plant resistance to insects** is often achieved through genetic modifications or breeding techniques that increase the plant’s natural defenses.
 
 
 
• **Increases stem width**__
 __
 
• Increasing stem width is primarily influenced by another class of plant hormones called **gibberellins** and **cytokinins**.
 
 
 
• **Induce flowering**__
 
 
• While auxins are involved in many growth processes, the induction of flowering is mainly regulated by **florigen** and other specific flowering hormones.
